what_this_file_is: The analysis set of the benchmark: one row per (arm, prompt, repeat), the run that stands for each of them.  The 60 compromised runs of the main run are taken from the rerun (launch-2026-11-01-v6h, the fixed runner with a fresh working directory per run); the 6 runs of the K04 prompt are taken from their own batch (launch-2026-11-03-v6i); the other 174 are the original runs of the main run (launch-2026-10-28-v6c).  The original run directory is read-only and untouched.
rule: the last attempt of a run counts; every superseded attempt is kept aside in <run-dir>/attempts and is not part of the analysis path
